## Problem overview

As the scope of US military operations expands in and around the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's economy faces unprecedented challenges. Sanctions, military threats, and regional instability threaten to further destabilize an already fragile economic environment. The implications of these developments extend beyond Iran, affecting global oil markets and international relations.

## Why this matters globally

Understanding the trajectory of Iran's economy is critical not only for regional players but for global markets. The Strait of Hormuz is a vital artery for oil transportation, and any disruption can lead to significant economic repercussions worldwide. Moreover, the geopolitical landscape in the Middle East is heavily intertwined with economic stability, making it essential to monitor these developments.
